PACKMASTER-HANDY_HAVERSACK.title: Handy Haversack
PACKMASTER-HANDY_HAVERSACK.description: At the start of each combat, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
PACKMASTER-BAG_OF_HOLDING.title: Bag of Holding
PACKMASTER-BAG_OF_HOLDING.description:
Replaces [gold]Handy Haversack[/gold].
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn, lasting 1 turn for every 5 cards in your deck.
PACKMASTER-BAG_OF_HOLDING.flavor: "Incredible! It appears that this bag connects to an extradimensional space. What if I jump inside?" - Ranwid
PACKMASTER-COLLECTOR_BADGE.title: Collector Badge
PACKMASTER-COLLECTOR_BADGE.description: Each turn, after you play a card from 3 different Packs, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} next turn.
PACKMASTER-GEM_OF_UNITY.title: Gem of Unity
PACKMASTER-GEM_OF_UNITY.description: Once per combat, after you play a card from each active Pack this run, gain {Block} [gold]Block[/gold], {StrengthPower} [gold]Strength[/gold], {DexterityPower} [gold]Dexterity[/gold], and heal {Heal} HP.
PACKMASTER-PM_BOOSTER_PACK.title: P.M. Booster Pack
PACKMASTER-PM_BOOSTER_PACK.description: Upon pickup, choose 1 card from a random Pack to add to your deck.
PACKMASTER-PM_BOOSTER_PACK.flavor: A package of cards in a foil wrapper. How did it end up in the Spire?
PACKMASTER-PM_BOOSTER_PACK.selectionScre: Choose a card from this Pack to add to your deck.
PACKMASTER-PM_COLLECTION.title: P.M. Collection
PACKMASTER-PM_COLLECTION.description: Upon pickup, you may add any number of cards from a random Pack to your deck.
PACKMASTER-PM_COLLECTION.flavor: Said to have been assembled by a consortium of wizards.
PACKMASTER-PM_COLLECTION.selectionScreen: Choose any number of cards from this Pack to add to your deck.
